xmldoc.short_description: Partition data into clusters using medoids.

syntax.syntax_item: [idx, C, sumd, D, midx, info] = kmedoids(...)

description.p: kmedoids clusters rows of X using a serial PAM-style update loop and Nelson's random generator for random starts.

example_item.example_item_description: Cluster observations and return medoid information.
example_item.example_item_data: X = [0; 1; 10; 11]; [idx, C, sumd, D, midx, info] = kmedoids(X, 2, 'Start', [1; 3])

example_item.example_item_description: Use cityblock distance for two-dimensional observations.
